title: Peak rate vs sustained model arithmetic
caption: The H100's dense FP16 peak is 989 TFLOP/s; ResNet-50 training at MLPerf's ~5,000 images/s per accelerator sustains ~123 TFLOP/s of model work — an MFU of about 12.4%. The rest goes to memory-bound layers, the input pipeline, and launch overhead.

title: A 5× inference speedup lands as 1.8× end to end
caption: Fictional serial pipeline at fixed stage times: 8 ms preprocessing plus 10 ms inference. Inference at 5× gives 18 → 10 ms total (1.8×); infinitely fast inference still leaves the 8 ms the optimization never touched (2.25× ceiling).

title: The boundary moves the measured energy
caption: One median text prompt: 0.10 Wh at the accelerators alone; 0.24 Wh counting everything the service draws — 58% active accelerators, 25% host CPUs and DRAM, 17% idle reserve and overhead. Same prompt, same machines; only the meter boundary changed.
